detail.longDescription: I joined # mastodon as part of # fedi22 . Here’s my intro as I transition from @ VTDARKSIM@toot.community to @ VTDARKSIM . I’m Chris. I live in Alexandria, VA, USA with my wife & Fluff (the # DuchessofWestEnd ). I have a BS # MechanicalEngineering from # VirginiaTech in # BlacksburgVA , a MS # MarineEngineering from the # USMerchantMarineAcademy # USMMA in # KingsPointNY , & am finishing a MS in # Analytics # OMSA from # GeorgiaTech # GaTech # GT in # AtlantaGA . I used to work as a # MarineEngineer , transitioned to # ReliabilityEngineering for the past 12 years, & am now looking to leverage that experience & pivot into # DataAnalysis . I tinker w/ # SmartHome stuff & am exploring # SelfHosting options w/ # Linux # Ubuntu on an old # MacMini . Currently running a mix of # HomeAssistant , # HAOS , # Hubitat , # Docker , # AdGuard , # ProtonVPN , # Jellyfin , # Mealie , # BarAssistant , # HomeBox , # Frigate , # Baserow , # TconnectSync , # NightGuard , # Ente , & # Authentik , w/ some of that behind # Caddy . Also running # Recalbox on a # RaspberryPi # RPi3 for # RetroGaming . Love # Hokies football. I’ve run an adult coed # soccer team loosely associated w/ the # VaTech # VT alumni association for ~20 years. I’m slowly trying to turn our # garden back yard into a # sustainable mini # farm # homestead when the mosquitos allow me to be a # landman . I like # DIY # building structurally sound if not aesthetically tolerable things, mostly # woodworking & # repairing /#repurposing old materials. I enjoy # CraftBeer & collecting nicer # alcohol . I’m a lifelong # Type1Diabetic w/ a # Tandem # InsulinPump & # Dexcom # CGM , so I occasionally rant about # T1D # Type1Diabetes # Diabetes # DiabeticProblems . Otherwise you’d never know I have it. I like to # travel but don’t do it enough. It’s maddening we don’t learn from other countries. I lean heavily to the left. I do not suffer nazis, fascists, sexists, bigots, racists, billionaires, capitalists, etc. If your politics depend on others having less, fuck off. Basically, # DontBeADick .
